Required Fields on a New Contract

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn what happens when you save a contract without its required fields, such as the employee and the start date.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Employees menu

Open the Employees menu.

3. Contracts

Click Contracts.

4. New

Click New to start a contract.

5. Save

Click the save icon without filling anything in.

6. Read the message

Read the red message. Click it to continue.

7. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
